fields.label: Editing a case study
fields.message: Safe to duplicate: duplicate an existing Case Study, then replace the text, logo, metrics, and proof below. These fields change content only; they do not change the page design. Required fields are the minimum needed for a complete page.

fields.label: Client name
fields.name: client_name
fields.instructions: e.g. "Alexis Delivery Service" — used in the breadcrumb and page title.

fields.label: Client logo
fields.name: client_logo
fields.instructions: Upload a wide, horizontal logo with transparent background where possible. It is displayed small in the hero (about 150 × 14 px), so avoid square logos or logos with tiny text.

fields.label: Industry / tag line
fields.name: industry_tag
fields.instructions: e.g. "Dallas · Moving & Delivery" — shown as the hero eyebrow.

fields.label: Client live site URL
fields.name: live_url
fields.instructions: Optional — shown as "View live site" link in the hero.

fields.label: Hero title
fields.name: hero_title
fields.instructions: Large headline in the opening hero. For one italic accent phrase only, wrap it in ...; otherwise use plain text.

fields.label: Hero stat rows
fields.name: hero_stats

sub_fields.label: Value
sub_fields.name: value
sub_fields.instructions: e.g. "25+", "#3", "8" — plain text, HTML allowed for a superscript span.

fields.instructions: Add 2–3 short proof points shown under the hero copy. Each row needs a small label and a prominent value; the layout is handled automatically.

fields.label: Chart current value
fields.name: chart_current_value
fields.instructions: e.g. "1,297" — the big number shown above the chart.

fields.label: Chart badge text
fields.name: chart_badge
fields.instructions: e.g. "Built from zero in 24 months"

fields.label: Chart data points
fields.name: chart_points
fields.instructions: Enter plain numbers only, oldest to newest (for example monthly traffic). The chart line is drawn automatically; do not add commas, % signs, or labels here.

fields.label: Context pills
fields.name: context_pills

sub_fields.label: Icon (lucide name)
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: Use a simple Lucide icon name, e.g. tag, map-pin, calendar, or search. If unsure, leave the existing icon and change only the text.

fields.instructions: Add 1–4 short context pills below the hero, such as industry, location, engagement length, or service type.

fields.label: Strategy section title
fields.name: strategy_title
fields.instructions:
HTML allowed,
for a line break.

fields.label: Strategy lede paragraph
fields.name: strategy_lede
fields.instructions: HTML allowed, e.g. wrap the last sentence in ....

fields.label: Strategy cards
fields.name: strategy_cards
fields.instructions: Add 1–4 strategy cards. They are numbered automatically in the order shown, so no numbering is needed in the text.

fields.label: Results section title
fields.name: results_title
fields.instructions: HTML allowed, e.g. emphasis.

fields.label: Results metrics
fields.name: results_metrics
fields.instructions: 2-4 metric tiles.

fields.label: Keyword table caption
fields.name: table_caption
fields.default_value: A sample of the keywords ranking today

fields.label: Keyword rows
fields.name: keyword_rows
fields.instructions: Optional keyword ranking table.

fields.label: FAQ section mode
fields.name: faq_mode
fields.instructions: Add optional case-specific FAQs or hide the section. Existing case studies remain unchanged until FAQ rows are added.

fields.label: FAQ section heading
fields.name: faq_title
fields.instructions: Optional. Leave blank to use “Questions about this project”.

fields.label: FAQ section introduction
fields.name: faq_sub
fields.instructions: Optional short paragraph shown below the FAQ heading.

fields.label: FAQ questions and answers
fields.name: faqs
fields.instructions: Add, remove, or drag rows to reorder the questions. The entire section stays hidden when no rows are present.

fields.label: Related case studies
fields.name: related_case_studies
fields.instructions: Pick up to 2 other case studies to feature at the bottom of this page.

fields.label: Fallback SEO title (Yoast takes priority)
fields.name: seo_title
fields.instructions: Leave blank to auto-generate from client name.
